exposure: Induction of labor at 37, 38, and 39 weeks compared to expectant management
cohort: 863 women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) who underwent either induction of labor (IOL) or spontaneous labor at or after 37 weeks gestation
finding: Induction of labor (IOL) at 37-40 weeks gestation in women with GDM was associated with similar cesarean delivery rates compared to expectant management, but rates differed based on cervical exam findings and parity.
